selected_experts.reason: To verify if the generated items are correctly identified as specific bakery products (cakes, tarts) and not generic food blobs.
To check for fusion between the paper liners and the metal rack, and ensure the wire rack has continuous, logical topology.
To assess the realism of the textures (frosting, metal, glass) and identify subtle generative artifacts in the lighting and reflections.
To confirm the presence and legibility of the 'Mei.Ai' watermark, which serves as a provenance marker.
To verify the depth relationship between the glass front, the cakes, and the back of the case, ensuring no spatial bleeding.

focus_areas: Structural integrity of wire racks (continuity and connection to frame)
Boundary sharpness between cake liners and rack (fusion/melting)
Texture realism of frosting and fruit toppings
Consistency of lighting and reflections on glass surfaces
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the interaction between the solid objects (cakes) and the supporting structure (wire rack). AI often struggles with thin structures like wire racks occluding or supporting objects. Check if the rack bars disappear unnaturally under the cakes. Also, evaluate if the 'stains' on the bottom are realistic dirt/spills or just noise patterns. The classifier should confirm these are distinct bakery items despite any minor geometric warping.
